For the sake of discussion, would you be willing to explain afrobeat? I have heard of it, but don't know what sets it apart from other genres.

Welcome! Sure, I'm by no means an expert but from what I've been able to find it originated in Nigeria and Ghana and then spread to other countries in the 70's. Main characteristics being chants and rhythmic vocals. Mainly rhythm driven with complicated rhythms interacting with each other. Lots of instruments; guitars, brass, drum set and congas. The rhythm basis is probably inspired from traditional African drumming etc. Also quite a political genre as their were a lot of changes in African countries moving into a post-colonial era.

It can be a bit confusing because the term seems to be used by modern Afro House artists these days (which probably has some influences from 70's afrobeat I suppose).

Anyway I'm not an expert! I'd love to hear anyone else's input or corrections!

  • Creators: Who create the actual content being consumed, whether it be music, code, art or sports
